## What and why

## How it was checked

- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make live`, when a tool or the gate changed
- [ ] A change to the gates: a unit test in `gate.rs`
- [ ] UI change: a screenshot or a short GIF of the window
- [ ] A change people will notice: a line under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No personal data: no home paths, email addresses, names, customer data, or machine identifiers in code, tests, fixtures, or text
